paper_title: Novel Constraints on Axions Produced in Pulsar Polar-Cap Cascades
notes: Fiducial (Conservative) 95% CL upper limit on g_agamma from Fig. 3 (LimitGP.png in the e-print), digitized by pixel analysis of the raster figure: marker centers located to ~1 px against the axis tick calibration (x decades 1e-9..1e-5 eV, y decades 1e-10..1e-13 GeV^-1). The curve is the paper's headline result: the weaker of the PIC-simulation and semi-analytic-model limits at each of the 5 masses, from radio observations of 27 nearby pulsars. Constraint does not assume axions are dark matter, so no rho_DM rescaling applies. The hatched band around the curve (modeling uncertainty) was not traced. No ancillary data file in the e-print.
